title: Integration pattern T-chart
goal: A software architecture class can contrast event-driven and request-response integration.

rubric.must: Two clearly headed columns for the integration patterns are visible.
Each side contains multiple readable comparison statements.
The two columns have equal visual status.

ideal.notes: Drafted by Codex from the source, the rubric and the comparison/tchart exemplar, without seeing the engine's own output.

review.evidence: The target is a readable, balanced T-chart titled “Event-driven versus request-response integration.” Both columns show their headings and all three source statements, with a clear central divider and no visible clipping or overlap.

items.evidence: Two clearly headed columns are labeled “Event-driven” and “Request-response.”
Each column contains three readable statements matching the source data.
The two columns have matching panel size, heading treatment, and visual weight.
A prominent vertical divider separates the columns, with a horizontal rule across their top.
The title clearly identifies the comparison; headings and statements are readable.
